prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with whiplash after a hit while turning left. The patient had 29 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1394; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Imaging and exam findings clearly confirm the injury.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text:
Patient presented following a motor vehicle collision in which their vehicle was struck while executing a left turn. The reported mechanism of injury is consistent with the nature and force of the impact. Presenting complaints were neck pain, restricted cervical range of motion, and headaches consistent with cervical strain and whiplash-associated disorder. Cervical imaging and physical examination findings clearly confirm the soft tissue injury. There is no known prior injury or treatment involving the same body region.

Over the course of care, the patient completed 29 visits consisting of manual therapy, therapeutic exercise, and home exercise instruction. Treatment followed a typical clinical progression, with visit frequency tapering as symptoms and range of motion improved. Billing records reflect single charges for each service rendered, with no duplicate or repeated billing observed.

At the time of discharge, the patient was improving and was instructed to continue a home exercise program. Follow-up was recommended on an as-needed basis should symptoms recur.
